graphics_vs_product.exclude_option: Exclude marketing/print-only; retain explicit web/app interface roles
graphics_vs_product.consequence: Changes marketing designers' cohort and Adobe/soft-skill frequencies; never use company sector alone
graphics_vs_product.recommendation: Retain explicit interface activity proposals; ask Phát about mixed or marketing-only work

industrial_plc.include_option: Include PLC/HMI control programming within IT/OT
industrial_plc.exclude_option: Limit IT to software systems/embedded; exclude PLC-only industrial work
industrial_plc.consequence: PLC jobs may have real C++/Python; do not remove WMS software development with PLC integration
industrial_plc.recommendation: Keep software development clear cases; defer PLC-only policy to Phát

telecom_field_installation.include_option: Include RAN/tower installation in ICT scope
telecom_field_installation.exclude_option: Include software/network operations but exclude tower/site construction
telecom_field_installation.consequence: Affects installation/QC rows, not all telecommunications employers or network engineers
telecom_field_installation.recommendation: Phát decides physical site-installation scope; preserve both proposed IDs pending decision

embedded_vs_machining.exclude_option: Exclude CNC/CAM machine operation and physical mould design
embedded_vs_machining.consequence: Distinguish firmware code from CNC toolpaths; no blanket hardware exclusion
embedded_vs_machining.recommendation: Retain firmware developer; propose excluding clearly observed machining activities by ID

bim_vs_software.include_option: Include software plugin development for BIM/CAD
bim_vs_software.exclude_option: Exclude structural drafting/modelling without software-development duties
bim_vs_software.consequence: BIM domain alone cannot decide; source-truncated modeler remains unresolved
bim_vs_software.recommendation: Retain actual Command/Plugin coding; obtain/decide missing role context for structural modeler

hardware_test_vs_software.consequence: Semiconductor equipment cycle test is not automatically software QA
hardware_test_vs_software.recommendation: Ask Phát to define hardware-test boundary; do not infer firmware duty from title Test Engineer

mechanical_vs_software.include_option: Include engineering automation where coding is a primary duty
mechanical_vs_software.exclude_option: Exclude mechanical CAD/material development without such duties
mechanical_vs_software.consequence: Python/VBA metadata does not establish the actual job activity, especially in truncated source
mechanical_vs_software.recommendation: Keep this role unresolved until activity/scope is clear
